header: Four steps to a themed TYPO3 site
description: No configuration files and no licence keys. If you prefer, the maintainers install and set up Desiderio for €890.

items.title: Install
items.description: Run composer require webconsulting/desiderio on TYPO3 v14.3 or later with PHP 8.4 or later. It brings all 244 elements, 62 components and the theme layer.

image.title: Developer laptop with code
image.alternative: Hands typing on a laptop keyboard.

items.title: Seed
items.description: Run desiderio:styleguide:seed once to create a complete demo site with all 244 elements and realistic content. It is safe to repeat and works in workspaces.

image.title: Desiderio page module preview
image.alternative: The TYPO3 page module with seeded Desiderio content elements and their backend previews.
image.description: Screenshot of a TYPO3 v14 site with Desiderio.

items.title: Theme
items.description: Pick one of 15 shadcn presets in the site settings, or a different one per page subtree. The site changes at runtime, dark mode included.

image.title: Desiderio theme site settings
image.alternative: The TYPO3 site settings with the Desiderio theme preset options.
image.description: Screenshot of a TYPO3 v14 site with Desiderio.

items.title: Create
items.description: Editors build pages from 244 elements with backend previews, or edit on the page itself in the Visual Editor. No training course needed.

image.title: Editing in the Desiderio Visual Editor
image.alternative: A Desiderio content element being edited on the page in the TYPO3 Visual Editor.
image.description: Screenshot of a TYPO3 v14 site with Desiderio.
